differences.location: entire lower-right ruled/curved group
differences.C: Graphic paths without an explicit cancellation assertion

differences.reading: Observed rules and curves retained, with cancelled/live status unresolved.
differences.evidence: The broad group has repeated nearvertical strokes at its left, a retraced upper rule with a hooked right return, a long oblique rising from the lower-left, and several crossing curves with hooked ends. differences.qualification: Qualified difference from H; no conclusive assertion of an H error. Source C did not explicitly assert either cancellation state.

differences.location: complete principal drawing field
differences.C: Detailed TikZ field; all 68 source fill-path blocks retained after direct visual reading
differences.H:
\drawing{feuillet de dessins de la même famille que la page 9 : disques coupés
de cordes, une région triangulaire ou quadrangulaire hachurée, trois marqués
« OK », des variantes introduites par « ou » ; sous eux les graphes : un
triangle, un point, un tripode épais en « Y », un carré, un triangle
surmonté d'un segment, un rectangle coupé d'une diagonale, un triangle à
point intérieur. À droite, deux axes fléchés en équerre et, dans l'angle,
des courbes qui se croisent et deux disques coupés d'arcs}
differences.reading: Complete geometric transcription, including local retracings, interrupted pieces, open loops, dark points, parentheses, auxiliary looped marks, shared contacts, arrow hooks, and the triangle’s three interior spokes.
differences.evidence: H supplies a verbal description of the drawing field. Its text names the principal shapes but leaves their detailed geometry, detached fragments, stroke placement, and several auxiliary marks unencoded. The full geometry is collated as this one descriptive-substitution locus. The separate explicit whole-group cancellation assertion is handled by D004.

notes.page_content: A drawing sheet. The principal field occupies the upper half: oval/chord constructions, eight short labels, a row of simpler graph-like drawings, two left miniature alternatives inside parentheses, and a large right-hand group of rules and crossing curves. Sparse detached traces remain in the lower field.

authors_own_uncertainty.comment: Four ou loci mark written alternatives, one reading remaining qualified. No prose statement of uncertainty is recovered. The upright looping/zigzag marks are preserved without assigning them a question mark or letter.

title_date_page_counts.comment: Archive numbering is represented only in a TeX comment.

notes.mathematical_reading_decisions: The short labels, boundary contacts, hatching, three interior spokes of the lower triangle, open loops and arrow hooks were read from visible strokes. No map, theorem, topological equivalence, or algebraic repair was supplied. No mathematical computation was performed.
notes.source_boundary: The final unnumbered section in packet H.tex and its note explicitly concern feuillet 13. That tail is contextual apparatus for another sheet and is excluded from scan012 transcription and collation. The H drawing description and rereading note before that boundary apply to scan012.
notes.H_collation_policy: The descriptive replacement of the principal drawing field is one D006 locus. Individual missing fragments within it are fully identified without repeating diff_H=true. The explicit biffé assertion remains a separate qualified state difference D004. Sparse lower-field omissions outside the described drawing field have their own local rows.
notes.abbreviation_source: The notation and abbreviation table rows in C_doubts.txt are kept in their own categories. The three actual doubtful-reading rows alone form C.DR1–C.DR3. The supplied C_notes.txt is empty.
notes.handwriting: Principal dark drawing and labels: his hand, following the packet and visible consistency. Archive foot: unnamed archival hand. All newly retained small/pale detached traces: undetermined hand; authorial intention and surface origin are unresolved.
notes.graphics: All 68 original C fill-path blocks are retained exactly after visual comparison. Two local unsure wrappers attach the open state questions to the respective drawing clusters. The first cluster includes a source path also extending into the lower miniature; the uncertainty target is explicitly restricted to the large oval. Thirty-one manually specified visible-mark entries supplement the source. No character is substituted for an unassigned shape.

image_views.comment: A first tool return attempted to include crop 04 after crop 03 but discarded crop 04 at the output limit. The same existing crop 04 was then displayed alone; it was not recropped. The first tool return for crop 16 was truncated before its image was visible; the same existing file was displayed afterward. Five final crops inspected previously unresolved faint lower-field traces. No whole/half image was revisited and no decided locus was recropped.

notes.scope: Only the assigned packet, brief, PREAMBLE, notation snapshot, original scan and supplied halves were read. No web, OCR, other page, other reader, compiler, rendering, package installation, or mathematical repair was used.
